name: What should I do to prepare for a luxury home staging consultation?

mainEntity.name: What should I do to prepare for a luxury home staging consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for a luxury home staging consultation, it's beneficial to have completed any major repairs or deep cleaning. While not mandatory, having a general understanding of your timeline and goals for selling can help tailor the advice. Kelby Contreras recommends documenting any key features or recent upgrades you wish to highlight. This information helps us understand your property's unique selling propositions and guides our staging recommendations effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare for a luxury staging consultation by completing major repairs, deep cleaning, and documenting key features or upgrades. Knowing your selling goals also helps tailor advice.
